ImageDescription.value: Page 1 includes portrait of Walter S. Fulton, county prosecutor in the Charles Nordstrom case. The case is discussed further on page 4. Nordstrom murdered William Mason in 1891 but due to a series of appeals by his lawyer, James Hamilton Lewis, was not hung until August 23, 1901. Page 6 includes portrait of Lillian B. Depew, three-time president of the Alpha Club.
